correctness.rationale: The defining quartic and birational normalization are explicit. For any m>=2 the dimension is N=4m-2 and the pulled-back plane system is exactly the three independent cusp-jet kernels. Imposing zero order k yields D-k-1 sections for 2<=k<=D-2, no nonzero sections at k=D-1; vanishing sequence is 0,2,...,D-2 and cusp weight D-3. Pluecker gives 3D-6 total, leaving degree three. S3 symmetry uniquely forces the harmonic smooth orbit of three simple points. This is an infinite proof independent of the finite SymPy experiments.

originality.rationale: Nawara establishes a rational cubic-Wronskian framework and smooth-quartic special examples but not the all-degree tricuspidal divisor. Maugesten–Moe gives the general conic-Wronskian method, not the all-degree tricuspidal formula. The classical Coolidge formula covers an unrefined m=2 count and is not claimed new. The exact cusp-jet model, all-m weight calculations, and S3-forced three-point residual orbit supply a structurally distinct all-degree classification. Full historical priority is provisional.

value.rationale: A complete all-degree normalised ramification classification of the maximally cuspidal rational plane quartic, identifying the exact cusp weights, the full Wronskian factor and three persistent simple smooth higher-order osculation points. It is structural and applies to infinitely many natural plane-form degrees, not merely a restatement of the known degree-two count.
